topic: Abandoned carts: Rs 1 lakh of sneakers left in cart
lines: Ek lakh rupay ke sneakers aapke cart mein chhode hue hain.
Customer ne size chuna, cart mein dala, phir call aa gaya.
Research ke mutabiq, dus mein se saat log cart chhod dete hain.
Aap bhool gaye. Smart system nahi bhoolta.
Ek ghante baad WhatsApp: aapke sneakers wait kar rahe hain.
Customer wapas aaya, order complete, paise aapke account mein.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Cart wapas lana hai? Comment CART.
